title: Dragon Diner Open to Dreams
description: A surreal scene inside a retro-futuristic diner set in a desert under a starry night sky. A woman in a pink bikini and headscarf sits on a bar stool taking a selfie with her phone, while a grand piano, a small dragon-like creature, and a giant stylized eye with a heart pupil float above, surrounded by musical notes and a serpentine blue dragon.
